prompt: The January report leaves out transactions on January 31. Someone assumed every month has 30 days. Fix that assumption everywhere in the acme package. A subscription renews on the same day next month, or on that month's last day if the next month is shorter. Pay and prorated quotas use the actual length of the month. Whole months between two dates counts fully completed calendar months only. Anything that really means a fixed number of days stays as it is.
